panels.title: Wallets inconsistentes (vazio = saudável)
panels.description: Saldo materializado × saldo reconstruído pelo ledger. Qualquer linha aqui é incidente crítico.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.id AS wallet_id, w.balance::text AS saldo, COALESCE(SUM(CASE l.direction WHEN 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END), 0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS ledger
FROM wallets w LEFT JOIN wallet_ledger_entries l ON l.wallet_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.id, w.balance
HAVING w.balance <> COALESCE(SUM(CASE l.direction WHEN 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END), 0)

panels.title: Volume creditado e debitado por dia (exato, NUMERIC)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS dia, currency AS moeda, direction AS direcao,
       count(*) AS lancamentos, SUM(amount)::numeric(20,2)::text AS volume
FROM wallet_ledger_entries WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 3

SELECT failure_code, kind, count(*) AS total
FROM wager_transactions WHERE status = 'REJECTED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT t.kind, a.action, COALESCE(a.failure_code, '-') AS failure_code, count(*) AS total
FROM wager_transaction_audit a JOIN wager_transactions t ON t.id = a.transaction_id
WHERE t.kind IN ('REFUND', 'ROLLBACK') AND $__timeFilter(a.occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Antifraude: jogadores com mais de 5 reversões na última hora

targets.rawSql:
SELECT player_id, count(*) AS reversoes, min(processed_at) AS primeira, max(processed_at) AS ultima
FROM wager_transactions
WHERE kind IN ('REFUND', 'ROLLBACK') AND status = 'PROCESSED' AND processed_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY player_id HAVING count(*) > 5 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT occurred_at, action, from_status, to_status, failure_code, ledger_entry_id, related_transaction_id, source, instance_id, correlation_id, message_id
FROM wager_transaction_audit
WHERE transaction_id::text = ${transactionId:sqlstring}
ORDER BY occurred_at, id
